brief:
A group of senior Israeli ex-military officials helped Palestinian farmers harvest olives on Tuesday in a show of solidarity, Middle East Eye reported. The action came as militant settler violence against Palestinians has escalated in recent weeks.

The ex-generals' participation in the harvest reflected divisions within Israeli society over settlement expansion and attacks on Palestinian communities. Their presence demonstrated opposition to the violence and support for Palestinian agricultural livelihoods.

title: Israeli ex-generals aid Palestinian olive harvest, condemn settler violence
